create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn.Graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs
set_and_get_graph_weights: set arc weights on a gtn.Graph using a list or numpy array and retrieve them
build_scalar_graph_and_negate: build a scalar graph with gtn.scalar_graph and negate its weight with gtn.negate
run_backward_autograd_on_graphs: run gtn.backward on the result of gtn.add to compute gradients on input graphs
test_parallel_operations_on_graph_list: test parallel operations like gtn.add and gtn.concat on lists of graphs
